steps.title: Set heat block temperature
steps.instruction: Turn on the heat block and set it to 37 °C.

steps.title: Label microcentrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Write the SampleID directly on the lid of each clean 0.5 mL microcentrifuge tube using a fine‑point Sharpie.

steps.title: Retrieve enzyme and buffer aliquots
steps.instruction: Remove one aliquot each of stock EcoRV‑HF enzyme and rCutSmart Buffer from the freezer, vortex gently to mix, and spin down in a mini‑spinner if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare EcoRV‑HF working solution
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, combine 62 µL rCutSmart Buffer with 62 µL stock EcoRV‑HF enzyme to make the working solution.

steps.title: Add enzyme to reaction tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1 µL of the EcoRV‑HF working solution into the bottom of each labeled 0.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add DNA template
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL of mtORF amplicon into each tube, double‑checking that the correct sample is added to the correct tube.

steps.title: Mix and spin down
steps.instruction: Gently flick each tube to mix, then spin the tubes down in a mini‑spinner.

steps.title: Incubate digestion reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate all tubes at 37 °C for 60 minutes, then raise the temperature to 65 °C and incubate for an additional 20 minutes.

steps.title: Analyze or store digests
steps.instruction: If possible, visualize the digests immediately on an agarose gel; otherwise, store the tubes in the refrigerator.
